deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout v2.3.1-build-894 to US canary (1% traffic). change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. details: https://internal.releases/redwood/1791234567

alice.gao: Thanks. checklist: capacity probe, latency SLOs, rollback triggers?

ben_k: Capacity probe succeeded in staging yesterday. For US canary we will ramp 1% -> 10% -> 30% in steps (10m hold then 50m steady) assuming no alerts. Target throughput per shard: 240 qps. Pre-warming 8 nodes in us-west and enabling burst pool.

caroline: Monitoring: dashboards are live, synthetic canary traffic running. p95 <= 400ms target for canary; p99 < 800ms. Rollback triggers: p95 > 500ms for 5m OR error-rate > 2% for 3m -> rollback.

dmitri: Add queue-depth > 50 sustained for 2m as a rollback trigger. Also pin enterprise routing to v2.2.9 for 24h to avoid customer impact. I'll push the pin now.

eva.s: Noted. I'll notify CS and the on-call rotation. I'll prepare release notes for #announcements after EU goes green.

infra-oncall: Scaling policy: us-west pool min=12, max=120, burst=30. Autoscaler warmup 90s. Watching instance provisioning and pod-scheduling. Alert if provisioning latency > 3m.

alice.gao: APAC hold until EU stable and capacity checks pass in EU. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, staggered by region. Any objections?

ben_k: :thumbsup: No objections. Also enabling KV-prefix caching for the canary to reduce token compute by ~12%.

caroline: Pinning note for the log: enterprise routing configured as `route: enterprise -> v2.2.9` in model-routing config.

deploy-bot: deploy update: canary ramp to 10% in 10m. status=ok. logs: `200/200 probes passed`

alice.gao: If anything trips, follow rollback playbook 2B: fast rollback -> notify customers -> run quick postmortem. Keep communications tight.

dmitri: Will trigger postmortem if rollback. For now monitoring looks stable; planning ramp to 30% in the next 60m if no alerts.

infra-oncall: Note: memory footprint increased ~6% on v2.3.1 compared to v2.2.9. Keeping extra headroom on pools. Watching OOM and swap churn.

ben_k: Draft release notes highlights: improved KV-caching heuristics, kernel attention optimizations, smarter batching. Will finalize after EU canary. cc @eva.s

eva.s: Copy. I'll draft the external announcement and internal changelog. ETA ~2h.

deploy-bot: deploy status: US at 30% (success). health=healthy. Next action: EU canary scheduled at +2h from now (approx).

caroline: Quick pre-probe: EU pre-probe shows capacity shortfall in eu-central: need +3 nodes to hit throughput target at 10% canary. infra-oncall please confirm.

infra-oncall: Spinning 3 spot instances in eu-central now. ETA ~4m. Also enabling burst pool for EU to absorb spikes. Monitoring provisioning.

alice.gao: Holding EU start until +6m to let nodes settle. Team please watch dashboards closely :eyes: Do not proceed to APAC until EU is stable for 30m.

deploy-bot: EU canary scheduled: start=1791238167. Will post updates when EU canary begins.
